ValidationRule.description: If the Case origin is Email or Phone, it should not be auto closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name == 'Service Request', OR(ISPICKVAL(Origin, 'Email'),ISPICKVAL(Origin, 'Phone')) , OR(ISPICKVAL( Status ,'Auto Closed') , ISPICKVAL( Authority_Status__c ,'Auto Approved')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select different value in Status or Authority Status fields. ‘Auto Closed’ and ‘Auto Approved’ can be used only for QAC Website cases.
